name: Nogah
overview: Nogah was a male member of the tribe of Judah, uniquely identified in Scripture as a son of King David. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical, with no additional personal notes or detailed narrative about his life recorded in the biblical text.
namesAndTitles: The name Nogah means 'joy' or 'splendor' in Hebrew, reflecting a positive and radiant meaning. This proper name, while not given directly by God, carries connotations of brightness and delight as found in 1 Chronicles 3:7.
familyAndRelationships: Nogah is explicitly recorded as a son of David, the renowned king of Israel. Beyond this father-son relationship, Scripture does not provide further family details or connections for Nogah.
scriptureSignificance: Nogah's significance lies chiefly in his place within the royal lineage of Judah as a son of David. This connection situates him within the Messianic line, emphasizing the continuity of God's covenant promises through David's descendants. Although little is said about him personally, his inclusion in the genealogical record affirms the faithfulness of God's plan across generations.
